name: Choice Mega-Chews | 200mg Gummies 2pk | Big Azz Blue Razz
description: 200mg packs are finally here! Get ready to chase the blues away with Choice Chew's Blue Raz Dream gummies! These sativa enhanced gummies harness the uplifting power of a sativa with that knock-out fruity flavor Choice Chews are known for. Made from scratch and infused with premium, high potency distillate, it's easy to see why these are a Michigan favorite!
